taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4 < ρ5 — continuously increasing resistivity with depth)
Aquifer depth: approximately 6.3 m – 37.3 m (resistive sand unit, Layer 4), with a deeper, even more resistive sand sequence (Layer 5) continuing below ~37 m
Recommendation: Target the coarse, resistive sand horizon between about 6 m and 37 m for the main water-bearing zone, screening this interval with appropriate gravel pack; drill to at least 45–50 m to confirm and potentially exploit the deeper high-resistivity sand (Layer 5) as a secondary, higher-yield aquifer.
